verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: Son of Man, turn your face toward the mountains of Israel, and come to them.
verses.3: And you said, “O Israelites, listen to the words of the Lord Jehovah. He said, ‘I will bring destruction upon you; I will destroy you with your dead bodies.’”
verses.4: And they will be destroyed from their idols. Their gods will be destroyed, and I will scatter your land before your eyes.
verses.5: And I will lay the carcasses of the Israelites before their graves. And I will scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.6: In all your places of worship, cities will be destroyed, and their ruins will be buried so that they can be destroyed and punished for your idols. Your altars will be destroyed, and your heathen practices will be eradicated. Your heat will be extinguished, and your evil deeds will be forgotten.
verses.7: And a space will fall upon you, and you will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.8: And I have become a refugee for you in the lands of your enemies, in your own countries.
verses.9: And remember your ancestors who were scattered in the lands where they lived. I have broken their hearts, and their eyes are filled with sorrow because of their actions. They turned away from God and chose evil over goodness.
verses.10: And they shall know that I, the LORD, have not spoken through them to do them this evil.
verses.11: “Thus said Adonai YHWH: ‘Let it fall upon your shoulders and beneath your feet.’ And I say, “Oh brother, to all the hardships and troubles that will befall the house of Israel during times of famine and disaster.”
verses.12: The faraway ones die in the wilderness; those who are close by die of hunger. The remaining ones also die from starvation. I am exhausted from all this suffering.
verses.13: Know that I, Jehovah, am in their midst, among their surroundings around their altars. I am everywhere on every high mountain, under every tree of the sun, and under every thick tree. It is there that a pleasant smell is given to all their altars.
verses.14: And I laid my hand on them, and I gave the land that was barren and desolate from the sea of Dibla to all their inhabitants. They shall know that I am Jehovah.
